breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify the contradiction between using a 'gamma-centered k-point grid' and a 'Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift'. Instead of resolving this conflict, the agent generated an unrelated clarification request about Hubbard U. The ground truth fixes the issue by removing the conflicting instruction about using a half shift.
